<thought>To find a retrosynthetic template for the carbonyl‑ene transformation, I will search the template catalog for reactions that break a hydroxyl group, form a ketone, and change a C=C bond order (i.e., convert an alkene to a C‑C single bond). This should return a template ID that can be used for the single‑step route.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles":"[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]","functional_groups_broken":["hydroxyl"],"functional_groups_formed":["ketone"],"bonds_order_changed":["C=C (1.0->2.0)","C=O (2.0->1.0)"],"limit":5}
